notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
